scenario: The installed skill version changed: pixz.core.planning now reports 2.1.0 where 2.0.0 was adapted. Detect the delta, inspect the actual change, identify behavioral implications, update activation knowledge, verify the updated knowledge and persist.
setup: adaptation-state.json ready at planning 2.0.0; registry now lists planning 2.1.0 with changed SKILL.md.
expected_behavior: E3 skill upgrade: probe reports STALE with the delta; agent inspects the actual diff (never assumes version change = behavior change), re-adapts only the delta, verifies, syncs and marks adapted.
failure_condition: Agent assumes behavior changed without inspecting the diff, reloads everything instead of the delta, or ignores the drift.
verification: lifecycle.skill-version-change + lifecycle.version-without-content pass; status reports version vs version-only drift distinctly.
verifies: skill-version-change adaptation: delta inspection before re-adaptation (mission E3, §14)
